title: Bitcoin Dominance Warning? Alts About To Collapse? Deep Dive Into Crypto
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: BTC.D retested its broken downtrend line; a push higher would mean alts drop 30-50% while BTC chops or pulls back ~10-20%.
Still thinks Bitcoin's cycle low is in despite near-term risk.

calls.condition: A daily close below 81,000 fails the bull flag and opens a 10-20% pullback toward the mid-70s/~70,000.
calls.reason: Bull flag gives a near-term bullish bias, but overhead trend line, prior bear-flag supply zone and a rising BTC dominance chart warn of a pullback.
calls.quote: the bull flag ... gives me a bullish bias near term. But ... Bitcoin could be on the verge of the bull flag failing

calls.reason: Holding his remaining short on Chainlink (in the money, break-even stop) because rising BTC dominance implies alts get crushed.
calls.quote: I have a short left on Chainlink ... I'm okay holding that based on what I'm seeing here
